full_judgment: 9. PW 2 SMA Kadir is the Assistant Chief Manager of Bhowal Raj Estate, who corroborated the plaintiff's case to the effect that the suit property was duly recorded in the name of the Deity Sri Sri Madhob both in SA and RS Khatians, and the vendor of the defendant-appellant named Chand Mia took settlement some portion of the suit land by executing registered kabulyats on 1-8-1963 (Exhibit-1 series) in favour of Bhowal Raj Estate. In cross, he says that after the abolition of Jamindari in 1950 the government acquired the properties of Bhowal Raj Estate save and except the choiced land and debutter land. He further stated in cross that the vendor of the appellant Chand Mia took Adhi-Barga of the suit land in 1371 BS for ten years and subsequently he was evicted from the suit land through process of law in pursuance of the Execution case. He further stated that they got recovery of possession through paper transaction but, in fact, could not got real possession of the property. On the other hand, the defendant side examined two witnesses. DW 1 Zobed Ali has stated that the suit land originally belonged to Bhowal Raj Estate from whom Chand Mia and Bashir Uddin took Pattan of the suit land and it was recorded in the names of Chand Mia, and Bashir Uddin in SA Khatian No. 63 (Exhibit ka-1). He denied the suggestion that Chand Mia took Barga by executing barga-kabulyat in favour of the Bhowal Raj Estate. But in cross, he says that Chand Mia took Adhi-Barga of the suit land by executing a kubilyat dated 1-8-1963 in favour of Bhowal Raj Estate and he purchased 1.05 acres of land from that Chand Mia. He further says that he cannot say whether the Bhowal Raj Estate obtained a decree for recovery of khas possession by evicting Chand Mia from the suit land. DW 2 Md Khadem Hossain, the Manager of the Court of Wards of the Bhowal Raj Estate, deposed but did not give any material evidence in this case.
